```{python}
#| label: fig-exclusion-wire-through-ignore-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The netlist of `exclusion_wire_through` with `ignore`. Open dots are ports, the wire is one resistor, and `A|B`, the node of the net, is tied to the port `A`."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.segments as seg
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2)
    d.config(fontsize=16)

    A = elm.Dot(open=True).label('A', loc='top')
    R = elm.Resistor().right().length(6).at(A.center).label('$2.596\\,\\Omega$')
    B = elm.Dot(open=True).label('B', loc='top')
    CA = elm.Capacitor().down().at(A.center).label('$2.664\\,\\mathrm{fF}$', loc='bottom').dot()
    CB = elm.Capacitor().down().at(B.center).label('$2.664\\,\\mathrm{fF}$').dot()
    Rail = elm.Line().endpoints(CA.end, CB.end)
    S = elm.Dot().at(Rail.center).label('sub!', loc='bottom', ofst=(0.5, 0))
    elm.Line().down().at(S.center).length(0.3)
    elm.Ground()
    RT = elm.Resistor().left().at(A.center).length(2.6).label('$1\\,\\mathrm{m\\Omega}$')
    elm.Dot().label('A|B', loc='top')
```
